subject: English
stimulus: (a) Bangladesh is one of the most resourceful places ⎯⎯. (b) It is a matter of irony that ⎯⎯. (c) There are many reasons ⎯⎯. (d) ⎯⎯, we have to make the best use of our resources. (e) ⎯⎯, we cannot make our country advanced in the world.
guide_solution: (a) Bangladesh is one of the most resourceful places in the world. (b) It is a matter of irony that we cannot utilize our resources. (c) There are many reasons why we cannot utilize our resources. (d) If we want to bring about the development of our country, we have to make the best use of our resources. (e) Unless we make the best use of our resources, we cannot make our country advanced in the world.
